+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""A small, self-contained Python port of the Nushell CLI surface used here.
+
+This is not a wrapper around the reference binary.  It implements the benchmark
+area directly: `nu -c` expressions and small scripts involving literals,
+pipelines, tables, JSON/CSV, string/math commands, and filesystem snippets.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import io
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Iterable
+
+
+class NuError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+NOTHING = object()
+
+
+@dataclass
+class RangeValue:
+    start: int
+    end: int
+    inclusive: bool = True
+
+    def values(self) -> list[int]:
+        step = 1 if self.end >= self.start else -1
+        stop = self.end + step if self.inclusive else self.end
+        return list(range(self.start, stop, step))
+
+
+def is_record(v: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(v, dict)
+
+
+def is_table(v: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(v, list) and (not v or all(isinstance(x, dict) for x in v))
+
+
+def to_iter(v: Any) -> list[Any]:
+    if v is NOTHING or v is None:
+        return []
+    if isinstance(v, RangeValue):
+        return v.values()
+    if isinstance(v, list):
+        return v
+    return [v]
+
+
+def display(v: Any) -> str:
+    if v is NOTHING:
+        return ""
+    if isinstance(v, RangeValue):
+        return "\n".join(str(x) for x in v.values())
+    if v is None:
+        return ""
+    if isinstance(v, bool):
+        return "true" if v else "false"
+    if isinstance(v, float):
+        if v.is_integer():
+            return str(int(v))
+        return ("%.12g" % v)
+    if isinstance(v, (int, str)):
+        return str(v)
+    if isinstance(v, list):
+        if all(not isinstance(x, (dict, list)) for x in v):
+            return "\n".join(display(x) for x in v)
+        return to_nuon(v)
+    if isinstance(v, dict):
+        return to_nuon(v)
+    return str(v)
+
+
+def compact_json(v: Any) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
+
+
+def pretty_json(v: Any) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+
+
+def to_nuon(v: Any) -> str:
+    if v is NOTHING or v is None:
+        return "null"
+    if isinstance(v, bool):
+        return "true" if v else "false"
+    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
+        return display(v)
+    if isinstance(v, str):
+        if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*", v):
+            return v
+        return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False)
+    if isinstance(v, RangeValue):
+        return f"{v.start}..{'' if v.inclusive else '<'}{v.end}"
+    if isinstance(v, list):
+        return "[" + ", ".join(to_nuon(x) for x in v) + "]"
+    if isinstance(v, dict):
+        return "{" + ", ".join(f"{k}: {to_nuon(val)}" for k, val in v.items()) + "}"
+    return str(v)
+
+
+def split_top(s: str, sep: str) -> list[str]:
+    out: list[str] = []
+    start = 0
+    depth = 0
+    quote: str | None = None
+    esc = False
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(s):
+        ch = s[i]
+        if quote:
+            if esc:
+                esc = False
+            elif ch == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif ch == quote:
+                quote = None
+        else:
+            if ch in "'\"`":
+                quote = ch
+            elif ch in "([{":
+                depth += 1
+            elif ch in ")]}":
+                depth -= 1
+            elif depth == 0 and s.startswith(sep, i):
+                out.append(s[start:i].strip())
+                i += len(sep)
+                start = i
+                continue
+        i += 1
+    out.append(s[start:].strip())
+    return [p for p in out if p != ""]
+
+
+def strip_outer(s: str, l: str, r: str) -> str | None:
+    s = s.strip()
+    if not (s.startswith(l) and s.endswith(r)):
+        return None
+    depth = 0
+    quote = None
+    esc = False
+    for i, ch in enumerate(s):
+        if quote:
+            if esc:
+                esc = False
+            elif ch == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif ch == quote:
+                quote = None
+        else:
+            if ch in "'\"`":
+                quote = ch
+            elif ch == l:
+                depth += 1
+            elif ch == r:
+                depth -= 1
+                if depth == 0 and i != len(s) - 1:
+                    return None
+    return s[1:-1] if depth == 0 else None
+
+
+TOKEN_RE = re.compile(
+    r"\s*(=>|==|!=|<=|>=|=~|!~|\.\.<|\.\.|\*\*|bit-shl|bit-shr|bit-and|bit-or|bit-xor|mod|and|or|xor|not|in|[(){}\[\],:;+\-*/<>]|\$?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_!?-]*|-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:kb|mb|b|sec|min)?|'(?:\\.|[^'])*'|\"(?:\\.|[^\"])*\")"
+)
+
+
+def tokenize(s: str) -> list[str]:
+    toks: list[str] = []
+    pos = 0
+    while pos < len(s):
+        if s[pos:].strip() == "":
+            break
+        m = TOKEN_RE.match(s, pos)
+        if not m:
+            raise NuError(f"parse error near {s[pos:pos+20]!r}")
+        toks.append(m.group(1))
+        pos = m.end()
+    return toks
+
+
+class Parser:
+    def __init__(self, shell: "NuShell", text: str, inp: Any = NOTHING):
+        self.shell = shell
+        self.toks = tokenize(text)
+        self.i = 0
+        self.inp = inp
+
+    def peek(self) -> str | None:
+        return self.toks[self.i] if self.i < len(self.toks) else None
+
+    def pop(self, want: str | None = None) -> str:
+        if self.i >= len(self.toks):
+            raise NuError("incomplete")
+        tok = self.toks[self.i]
+        if want is not None and tok != want:
+            raise NuError(f"expected {want}")
+        self.i += 1
+        return tok
+
+    def parse(self) -> Any:
+        val = self.parse_or()
+        if self.peek() is not None:
+            if self.peek() in ("..", "..<"):
+                incl = self.pop() == ".."
+                end = self.parse_or()
+                return RangeValue(int(val), int(end), incl)
+            raise NuError(f"unexpected {self.peek()}")
+        return val
+
+    def parse_or(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_and()
+        while self.peek() in ("or", "xor"):
+            op = self.pop()
+            r = self.parse_and()
+            v = (bool(v) or bool(r)) if op == "or" else (bool(v) ^ bool(r))
+        return v
+
+    def parse_and(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_cmp()
+        while self.peek() == "and":
+            self.pop()
+            v = bool(v) and bool(self.parse_cmp())
+        return v
+
+    def parse_cmp(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_add()
+        while self.peek() in ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=", "=~", "!~", "in"):
+            op = self.pop()
+            r = self.parse_add()
+            if v is None or r is None:
+                v = None
+            elif op == "==":
+                v = v == r
+            elif op == "!=":
+                v = v != r
+            elif op == "<":
+                v = v < r
+            elif op == "<=":
+                v = v <= r
+            elif op == ">":
+                v = v > r
+            elif op == ">=":
+                v = v >= r
+            elif op == "=~":
+                v = re.search(str(r), str(v)) is not None
+            elif op == "!~":
+                v = re.search(str(r), str(v)) is None
+            elif op == "in":
+                v = v in (r.keys() if isinstance(r, dict) else r)
+        return v
+
+    def parse_add(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_mul()
+        while self.peek() in ("+", "-", "bit-or", "bit-xor"):
+            op = self.pop()
+            r = self.parse_mul()
+            if op == "+":
+                v = v + r
+            elif op == "-":
+                v = v - r
+            elif op == "bit-or":
+                v = int(v) | int(r)
+            else:
+                v = int(v) ^ int(r)
+        return v
+
+    def parse_mul(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_pow()
+        while self.peek() in ("*", "/", "mod", "bit-and", "bit-shl", "bit-shr"):
+            op = self.pop()
+            r = self.parse_pow()
+            if op == "*":
+                v = v * r
+            elif op == "/":
+                v = v / r
+            elif op == "mod":
+                v = v % r
+            elif op == "bit-and":
+                v = int(v) & int(r)
+            elif op == "bit-shl":
+                if int(r) < 0 or int(r) > 128:
+                    raise NuError("exceeds available bits")
+                v = int(v) << int(r)
+            else:
+                if int(r) < 0 or int(r) > 128:
+                    raise NuError("exceeds available bits")
+                v = int(v) >> int(r)
+        return v
+
+    def parse_pow(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_unary()
+        if self.peek() == "**":
+            self.pop()
+            v = v ** self.parse_pow()
+        return v
+
+    def parse_unary(self) -> Any:
+        if self.peek() == "not":
+            self.pop()
+            return not bool(self.parse_unary())
+        if self.peek() == "-":
+            self.pop()
+            return -self.parse_unary()
+        return self.parse_primary()
+
+    def parse_primary(self) -> Any:
+        tok = self.pop()
+        if tok == "(":
+            parts: list[str] = []
+            depth = 1
+            while depth and self.i < len(self.toks):
+                t = self.pop()
+                if t == "(":
+                    depth += 1
+                elif t == ")":
+                    depth -= 1
+                    if depth == 0:
+                        break
+                parts.append(t)
+            return self.shell.eval_pipeline(" ".join(parts), self.inp)
+        if tok == "[":
+            return self.parse_list_or_table()
+        if tok == "{":
+            return self.parse_record()
+        if tok.startswith("$"):
+            return self.shell.lookup(tok[1:], self.inp)
+        if tok in ("true", "false"):
+            return tok == "true"
+        if tok == "null":
+            return None
+        if tok.startswith("'") or tok.startswith('"'):
+            return bytes(tok[1:-1], "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
+        if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:kb|mb|b|sec|min)?", tok, re.I):
+            return parse_number(tok)
+        return tok
+
+    def parse_list_or_table(self) -> Any:
+        if self.peek() == "]":
+            self.pop()
+            return []
+        rows: list[list[Any]] = []
+        cur: list[Any] = []
+        is_table_form = False
+        while True:
+            if self.peek() == "[":
+                self.pop("[")
+                row: list[Any] = []
+                while self.peek() != "]":
+                    if self.peek() == ",":
+                        self.pop()
+                        continue
+                    row.append(self.parse_or())
+                self.pop("]")
+                rows.append(row)
+                is_table_form = True
+            elif self.peek() == ";":
+                self.pop()
+                rows.insert(0, cur)
+                cur = []
+                is_table_form = True
+            elif self.peek() == "]":
+                self.pop()
+                break
+            elif self.peek() == ",":
+                self.pop()
+            else:
+                cur.append(self.parse_or())
+        if is_table_form:
+            if cur and not rows:
+                rows.append(cur)
+            if not rows:
+                return []
+            headers = [str(x) for x in rows[0]]
+            return [dict(zip(headers, row)) for row in rows[1:]]
+        return cur
+
+    def parse_record(self) -> Any:
+        rec: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        while self.peek() != "}":
+            if self.peek() == ",":
+                self.pop()
+                continue
+            key = self.pop()
+            if key.startswith("'") or key.startswith('"'):
+                key = bytes(key[1:-1], "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
+            if self.peek() != ":":
+                raise NuError("expected ':'")
+            self.pop(":")
+            rec[str(key)] = self.parse_or()
+        self.pop("}")
+        return rec
+
+
+def parse_number(tok: str) -> int | float:
+    m = re.fullmatch(r"(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(kb|mb|b|sec|min)?", tok, re.I)
+    if not m:
+        raise NuError("expected number")
+    n = float(m.group(1)) if "." in m.group(1) else int(m.group(1))
+    unit = (m.group(2) or "").lower()
+    if unit == "kb":
+        return int(n * 1000)
+    if unit == "mb":
+        return int(n * 1000 * 1000)
+    if unit == "min":
+        return int(n * 60)
+    if unit == "sec":
+        return int(n)
+    return n
+
+
+def parse_args_words(s: str) -> list[str]:
+    words: list[str] = []
+    cur = []
+    quote = None
+    esc = False
+    for ch in s.strip():
+        if quote:
+            if esc:
+                cur.append(ch)
+                esc = False
+            elif ch == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif ch == quote:
+                quote = None
+            else:
+                cur.append(ch)
+        else:
+            if ch in "'\"":
+                quote = ch
+            elif ch.isspace():
+                if cur:
+                    words.append("".join(cur))
+                    cur = []
+            else:
+                cur.append(ch)
+    if cur:
+        words.append("".join(cur))
+    return words

+    if isinstance(v, list):
+        return v
+    return [v]

+def display(v: Any) -> str:
+    if v is NOTHING:
+        return ""
+    if isinstance(v, RangeValue):
+        return "\n".join(str(x) for x in v.values())
+    if v is None:
+        return ""
+    if isinstance(v, bool):
+        return "true" if v else "false"
+    if isinstance(v, float):
+        if v.is_integer():
+            return str(int(v))
+        return ("%.12g" % v)
+    if isinstance(v, (int, str)):
+        return str(v)
+    if isinstance(v, list):
+        if all(not isinstance(x, (dict, list)) for x in v):
+            return "\n".join(display(x) for x in v)
+        return to_nuon(v)
+    if isinstance(v, dict):
+        return to_nuon(v)
+    return str(v)
+
+
+def compact_json(v: Any) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
+
+
+def pretty_json(v: Any) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+
+
+def to_nuon(v: Any) -> str:
+    if v is NOTHING or v is None:
+        return "null"
+    if isinstance(v, bool):
+        return "true" if v else "false"
+    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
+        return display(v)
+    if isinstance(v, str):
+        if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*", v):
+            return v
+        return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False)
+    if isinstance(v, RangeValue):
+        return f"{v.start}..{'' if v.inclusive else '<'}{v.end}"
+    if isinstance(v, list):
+        return "[" + ", ".join(to_nuon(x) for x in v) + "]"
+    if isinstance(v, dict):
+        return "{" + ", ".join(f"{k}: {to_nuon(val)}" for k, val in v.items()) + "}"
+    return str(v)
+

+def split_top(s: str, sep: str) -> list[str]:
+    out: list[str] = []
+    start = 0
+    depth = 0
+    quote: str | None = None
+    esc = False
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(s):
+        ch = s[i]
+        if quote:
+            if esc:
+                esc = False
+            elif ch == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif ch == quote:
+                quote = None
+        else:
+            if ch in "'\"`":
+                quote = ch
+            elif ch in "([{":
+                depth += 1
+            elif ch in ")]}":
+                depth -= 1
+            elif depth == 0 and s.startswith(sep, i):
+                out.append(s[start:i].strip())
+                i += len(sep)
+                start = i
+                continue
+        i += 1
+    out.append(s[start:].strip())
+    return [p for p in out if p != ""]
+
+
+def strip_outer(s: str, l: str, r: str) -> str | None:
+    s = s.strip()
+    if not (s.startswith(l) and s.endswith(r)):
+        return None
+    depth = 0
+    quote = None
+    esc = False
+    for i, ch in enumerate(s):
+        if quote:
+            if esc:
+                esc = False
+            elif ch == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif ch == quote:
+                quote = None
+        else:
+            if ch in "'\"`":
+                quote = ch
+            elif ch == l:
+                depth += 1
+            elif ch == r:
+                depth -= 1
+                if depth == 0 and i != len(s) - 1:
+                    return None
+    return s[1:-1] if depth == 0 else None
+

+TOKEN_RE = re.compile(
+    r"\s*(=>|==|!=|<=|>=|=~|!~|\.\.<|\.\.|\*\*|bit-shl|bit-shr|bit-and|bit-or|bit-xor|mod|and|or|xor|not|in|[(){}\[\],:;+\-*/<>]|\$?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_!?-]*|-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:kb|mb|b|sec|min)?|'(?:\\.|[^'])*'|\"(?:\\.|[^\"])*\")"
+)

+def tokenize(s: str) -> list[str]:
+    toks: list[str] = []
+    pos = 0
+    while pos < len(s):
+        if s[pos:].strip() == "":
+            break
+        m = TOKEN_RE.match(s, pos)
+        if not m:
+            raise NuError(f"parse error near {s[pos:pos+20]!r}")
+        toks.append(m.group(1))
+        pos = m.end()
+    return toks

+class Parser:
+    def __init__(self, shell: "NuShell", text: str, inp: Any = NOTHING):
+        self.shell = shell
+        self.toks = tokenize(text)
+        self.i = 0
+        self.inp = inp
+
+    def peek(self) -> str | None:
+        return self.toks[self.i] if self.i < len(self.toks) else None
+
+    def pop(self, want: str | None = None) -> str:
+        if self.i >= len(self.toks):
+            raise NuError("incomplete")
+        tok = self.toks[self.i]
+        if want is not None and tok != want:
+            raise NuError(f"expected {want}")
+        self.i += 1
+        return tok
+
+    def parse(self) -> Any:
+        val = self.parse_or()
+        if self.peek() is not None:
+            if self.peek() in ("..", "..<"):
+                incl = self.pop() == ".."
+                end = self.parse_or()
+                return RangeValue(int(val), int(end), incl)
+            raise NuError(f"unexpected {self.peek()}")
+        return val
+
+    def parse_or(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_and()
+        while self.peek() in ("or", "xor"):
+            op = self.pop()
+            r = self.parse_and()
+            v = (bool(v) or bool(r)) if op == "or" else (bool(v) ^ bool(r))
+        return v
+
+    def parse_and(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_cmp()
+        while self.peek() == "and":
+            self.pop()
+            v = bool(v) and bool(self.parse_cmp())
+        return v
+
+    def parse_cmp(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_add()
+        while self.peek() in ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=", "=~", "!~", "in"):
+            op = self.pop()
+            r = self.parse_add()
+            if v is None or r is None:
+                v = None
+            elif op == "==":
+                v = v == r
+            elif op == "!=":
+                v = v != r
+            elif op == "<":
+                v = v < r
+            elif op == "<=":
+                v = v <= r
+            elif op == ">":
+                v = v > r
+            elif op == ">=":
+                v = v >= r
+            elif op == "=~":
+                v = re.search(str(r), str(v)) is not None
+            elif op == "!~":
+                v = re.search(str(r), str(v)) is None
+            elif op == "in":
+                v = v in (r.keys() if isinstance(r, dict) else r)
+        return v
+
+    def parse_add(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_mul()
+        while self.peek() in ("+", "-", "bit-or", "bit-xor"):
+            op = self.pop()
+            r = self.parse_mul()
+            if op == "+":
+                v = v + r
+            elif op == "-":
+                v = v - r
+            elif op == "bit-or":
+                v = int(v) | int(r)
+            else:
+                v = int(v) ^ int(r)
+        return v
+
+    def parse_mul(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_pow()
+        while self.peek() in ("*", "/", "mod", "bit-and", "bit-shl", "bit-shr"):
+            op = self.pop()
+            r = self.parse_pow()
+            if op == "*":
+                v = v * r
+            elif op == "/":
+                v = v / r
+            elif op == "mod":
+                v = v % r
+            elif op == "bit-and":
+                v = int(v) & int(r)
+            elif op == "bit-shl":
+                if int(r) < 0 or int(r) > 128:
+                    raise NuError("exceeds available bits")
+                v = int(v) << int(r)
+            else:
+                if int(r) < 0 or int(r) > 128:
+                    raise NuError("exceeds available bits")
+                v = int(v) >> int(r)
+        return v
+
+    def parse_pow(self) -> Any:
+        v = self.parse_unary()
+        if self.peek() == "**":
+            self.pop()
+            v = v ** self.parse_pow()
+        return v
+
+    def parse_unary(self) -> Any:
+        if self.peek() == "not":
+            self.pop()
+            return not bool(self.parse_unary())
+        if self.peek() == "-":
+            self.pop()
+            return -self.parse_unary()
+        return self.parse_primary()
+
+    def parse_primary(self) -> Any:
+        tok = self.pop()
+        if tok == "(":
+            parts: list[str] = []
+            depth = 1
+            while depth and self.i < len(self.toks):
+                t = self.pop()
+                if t == "(":
+                    depth += 1
+                elif t == ")":
+                    depth -= 1
+                    if depth == 0:
+                        break
+                parts.append(t)
+            return self.shell.eval_pipeline(" ".join(parts), self.inp)
+        if tok == "[":
+            return self.parse_list_or_table()
+        if tok == "{":
+            return self.parse_record()
+        if tok.startswith("$"):
+            return self.shell.lookup(tok[1:], self.inp)
+        if tok in ("true", "false"):
+            return tok == "true"
+        if tok == "null":
+            return None
+        if tok.startswith("'") or tok.startswith('"'):
+            return bytes(tok[1:-1], "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
+        if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:kb|mb|b|sec|min)?", tok, re.I):
+            return parse_number(tok)
+        return tok
+
+    def parse_list_or_table(self) -> Any:
+        if self.peek() == "]":
+            self.pop()
+            return []
+        rows: list[list[Any]] = []
+        cur: list[Any] = []
+        is_table_form = False
+        while True:
+            if self.peek() == "[":
+                self.pop("[")
+                row: list[Any] = []
+                while self.peek() != "]":
+                    if self.peek() == ",":
+                        self.pop()
+                        continue
+                    row.append(self.parse_or())
+                self.pop("]")
+                rows.append(row)
+                is_table_form = True
+            elif self.peek() == ";":
+                self.pop()
+                rows.insert(0, cur)
+                cur = []
+                is_table_form = True
+            elif self.peek() == "]":
+                self.pop()
+                break
+            elif self.peek() == ",":
+                self.pop()
+            else:
+                cur.append(self.parse_or())
+        if is_table_form:
+            if cur and not rows:
+                rows.append(cur)
+            if not rows:
+                return []
+            headers = [str(x) for x in rows[0]]
+            return [dict(zip(headers, row)) for row in rows[1:]]
+        return cur
+
+    def parse_record(self) -> Any:
+        rec: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        while self.peek() != "}":
+            if self.peek() == ",":
+                self.pop()
+                continue
+            key = self.pop()
+            if key.startswith("'") or key.startswith('"'):
+                key = bytes(key[1:-1], "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
+            if self.peek() != ":":
+                raise NuError("expected ':'")
+            self.pop(":")
+            rec[str(key)] = self.parse_or()
+        self.pop("}")
+        return rec
+
+
+def parse_number(tok: str) -> int | float:
+    m = re.fullmatch(r"(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(kb|mb|b|sec|min)?", tok, re.I)
+    if not m:
+        raise NuError("expected number")
+    n = float(m.group(1)) if "." in m.group(1) else int(m.group(1))
+    unit = (m.group(2) or "").lower()
+    if unit == "kb":
+        return int(n * 1000)
+    if unit == "mb":
+        return int(n * 1000 * 1000)
+    if unit == "min":
+        return int(n * 60)
+    if unit == "sec":
+        return int(n)
+    return n
+
+
+def parse_args_words(s: str) -> list[str]:
+    words: list[str] = []
+    cur = []
+    quote = None
+    esc = False
+    for ch in s.strip():
+        if quote:
+            if esc:
+                cur.append(ch)
+                esc = False
+            elif ch == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif ch == quote:
+                quote = None
+            else:
+                cur.append(ch)
+        else:
+            if ch in "'\"":
+                quote = ch
+            elif ch.isspace():
+                if cur:
+                    words.append("".join(cur))
+                    cur = []
+            else:
+                cur.append(ch)
+    if cur:
+        words.append("".join(cur))
+    return words

+class NuShell:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.vars: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        self.cwd = Path.cwd()
+
+    def lookup(self, name: str, inp: Any) -> Any:
+        if name in ("in", "it"):
+            return inp
+        parts = name.split(".")
+        base = self.vars.get(parts[0], NOTHING)
+        for p in parts[1:]:
+            base = get_field(base, p)
+        return base
+
+    def eval_script(self, text: str) -> Any:
+        result: Any = NOTHING
+        for stmt in split_top(text.replace("\r\n", "\n"), ";"):
+            for line in [x.strip() for x in stmt.split("\n") if x.strip()]:
+                result = self.eval_statement(line)
+        return result
+
+    def eval_statement(self, stmt: str) -> Any:
+        if stmt.startswith("let ") or stmt.startswith("mut "):
+            _, rest = stmt.split(None, 1)
+            name, expr = rest.split("=", 1)
+            self.vars[name.strip().lstrip("$")] = self.eval_pipeline(expr.strip())
+            return NOTHING
+        if stmt.startswith("print "):
+            vals = [self.eval_pipeline(p) for p in split_top(stmt[6:], " ")]
+            print("".join(display(v) for v in vals))
+            return NOTHING
+        if stmt.startswith("exit"):
+            parts = stmt.split()
+            raise SystemExit(int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0)
+        return self.eval_pipeline(stmt)
+
+    def eval_pipeline(self, text: str, inp: Any = NOTHING) -> Any:
+        parts = split_top(text, "|")
+        val: Any = inp
+        for i, part in enumerate(parts):
+            if i == 0 and not looks_like_command(part):
+                val = Parser(self, part, val).parse()
+            else:
+                val = self.run_command(part, val)
+        return val
+
+    def run_command(self, part: str, inp: Any) -> Any:
+        part = part.strip()
+        if not part:
+            return inp
+        if part.startswith("$") or part[0] in "'\"([{" or re.match(r"-?\d", part):
+            return Parser(self, part, inp).parse()
+        words = parse_args_words(part)
+        if not words:
+            return inp
+        cmd = words[0]
+        args = words[1:]
+        if cmd == "echo":
+            return [self.eval_pipeline(a, inp) if is_expr(a) else a for a in args] if args else inp
+        if cmd == "collect":
+            return "".join(display(x) for x in to_iter(inp))
+        if cmd == "to":
+            return self.cmd_to(args, inp)
+        if cmd == "from":
+            return self.cmd_from(args, inp)
+        if cmd == "str":
+            return self.cmd_str(args, inp)
+        if cmd == "split":
+            return self.cmd_split(args, inp)
+        if cmd == "lines":
+            return str(inp).splitlines()
+        if cmd == "get":
+            return cmd_get(inp, args)
+        if cmd == "select":
+            return cmd_select(inp, args)
+        if cmd == "reject":
+            return cmd_reject(inp, args)
+        if cmd == "drop" and args[:1] == ["column"]:
+            return cmd_drop_column(inp, int(args[1]) if len(args) > 1 else 1)
+        if cmd == "columns":
+            if is_table(inp):
+                cols: list[str] = []
+                for r in inp:
+                    for k in r.keys():
+                        if k not in cols:
+                            cols.append(k)
+                return cols
+            if isinstance(inp, dict):
+                return list(inp.keys())
+            return []
+        if cmd == "values":
+            return list(inp.values()) if isinstance(inp, dict) else [list(r.values()) for r in to_iter(inp)]
+        if cmd == "length":
+            return len(to_iter(inp)) if not isinstance(inp, (str, dict)) else len(inp)
+        if cmd == "first":
+            items = to_iter(inp)
+            return items[0] if items else NOTHING
+        if cmd == "last":
+            items = to_iter(inp)
+            return items[-1] if items else NOTHING
+        if cmd == "math":
+            return self.cmd_math(args, inp)
+        if cmd == "where":
+            expr = part[len("where") :].strip()
+            return [x for x in to_iter(inp) if bool(Parser(self, expr, x).parse())]
+        if cmd == "each":
+            body = part[part.find("{") + 1 : part.rfind("}")].strip()
+            body = re.sub(r"^\|[^|]+\|", "", body).strip()
+            return [self.eval_pipeline(body, x) for x in to_iter(inp)]
+        if cmd == "sort":
+            return sorted(to_iter(inp), key=lambda x: str(x).lower() if "-i" in args else str(x))
+        if cmd == "sort-by":
+            ignore = "-i" in args
+            cols = [a for a in args if a != "-i"]
+            return sorted(to_iter(inp), key=lambda r: tuple(str(get_field(r, c)).lower() if ignore else str(get_field(r, c)) for c in cols))
+        if cmd == "flatten":
+            out: list[Any] = []
+            for x in to_iter(inp):
+                out.extend(to_iter(x))
+            return out
+        if cmd == "default" and len(args) >= 2:
+            val = Parser(self, args[0], inp).parse()
+            col = args[1]
+            return [{**r, col: r.get(col, val)} for r in to_iter(inp)]
+        if cmd == "open":
+            raw = "--raw" in args
+            paths = [a for a in args if not a.startswith("--")]
+            data = Path(paths[0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8") if paths else ""
+            if raw:
+                return data
+            if paths and paths[0].endswith(".json"):

+            return NOTHING
+        if cmd == "path" and args[:1] == ["exists"]:
+            return Path(str(inp)).exists()
+        if cmd == "char" and args[:1] == ["nl"]:
+            return "\n"
+        if cmd == "describe":
+            return describe(inp)
+        # Treat unknown bare words as expressions or external-ish no-op text.
+        return Parser(self, part, inp).parse()
+
+    def cmd_to(self, args: list[str], inp: Any) -> Any:
+        raw = "--raw" in args or "-r" in args
+        if args and args[0] == "json":
+            return compact_json(inp) if raw else pretty_json(inp)
+        if args and args[0] == "nuon":
+            return to_nuon(inp)
+        if args and args[0] == "csv":
+            return value_to_csv(inp)
+        return display(inp)
+
+    def cmd_from(self, args: list[str], inp: Any) -> Any:
+        text = display(inp)
+        if args and args[0] == "json":
+            return json.loads(text)
+        if args and args[0] == "csv":
+            return csv_to_value(text)
+        return inp
+
+    def cmd_str(self, args: list[str], inp: Any) -> Any:
+        op = args[0] if args else ""
+        def map_str(fn):
+            if isinstance(inp, list):
+                return [fn(str(x)) for x in inp]
+            return fn(str(inp))
+        if op == "upcase":
+            return map_str(lambda s: s.upper())
+        if op == "downcase":
+            return map_str(lambda s: s.lower())
+        if op == "length":
+            return len(str(inp))
+        if op == "join":
+            sep = self.eval_pipeline(args[1], inp) if len(args) > 1 else ""
+            return str(sep).join(display(x) for x in to_iter(inp))
+        if op == "contains":
+            return (args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "") in str(inp)
+        if op == "index-of":
+            return str(inp).find(args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "")
+        if op == "replace":
+            if len(args) < 3:
+                raise NuError("missing replacement")
+            return re.sub(args[1], args[2], str(inp))
+        if op == "substring":
+            spec = " ".join(args[1:]).strip("[]") if len(args) > 1 else ""
+            if ".." in spec:
+                a, b = re.split(r"\.\.<|\.\.", spec, 1)
+                start = 0 if a in ("", "_") else int(self.eval_pipeline(a, inp))
+                end = None if b in ("", "_") else int(self.eval_pipeline(b, inp))
+                return str(inp)[start:end]
+            return str(inp)
+        if op == "trim":
+            return str(inp).strip()
+        return inp

+    def cmd_split(self, args: list[str], inp: Any) -> Any:
+        if args and args[0] == "row":
+            sep = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "\n"
+            return str(inp).split(sep)
+        if args and args[0] == "column":
+            sep = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else " "
+            cols = args[2:] or ["column1", "column2"]
+            rows = []
+            for line in str(inp).splitlines():

+    def cmd_math(self, args: list[str], inp: Any) -> Any:
+        vals = [x for x in to_iter(inp) if isinstance(x, (int, float))]
+        op = args[0] if args else ""
+        if op == "sum":
+            return sum(vals)
+        if op == "avg":
+            return sum(vals) / len(vals) if vals else 0
+        if op == "min":
+            return min(vals)
+        if op == "max":
+            return max(vals)
+        return inp

+def looks_like_command(part: str) -> bool:

+    return first in {

+        "reject", "drop", "columns", "values", "length", "first", "last", "math",
+        "where", "each", "sort", "sort-by", "flatten", "default", "open", "save",
+        "path", "char", "describe",

+def get_field(v: Any, field: str) -> Any:
